_comment: Comparison configurations = memory system × model endpoint. Each runs into run id cfg__<provider>__<model>; the arm directory inside encodes the memory system (seq / mem_factsall / mem_fusednote). Edit freely; the UI reads this file on every /api/configs call. GPT presets use provider azure (Azure OpenAI); GPT ids asked of GoodVision are also served by Azure when it is configured (demo/providers.py gpt_route).

_comment_showcase: Showcase chains (/api/showcase; the compare page's chain list and the agent page's example chain): chains of the recorded paper run showcase_run where Knowledge Vault used >= showcase_margin fewer tokens than Mem0, MemOp and No memory alike and resolved at least as many tasks as each (>= 1). showcase_default = the chain the pages open on (DEMO_DEFAULT_CID overrides it only when it names a listed chain). title <= 6 words, blurb = one or two plain sentences (plain text: pages must escape it).

showcase_chains.title: Table-of-contents fixes
showcase_chains.blurb: Python-Markdown's TOC extension: unescape backslashes in heading ids, a configurable permalink title, no HTML placeholders in TOC names.

showcase_chains.title: Fix three SQL dialect bugs
showcase_chains.blurb: sqlglot translates SQL between databases. Fix a Snowflake PIVOT, quotes inside JSON keys and DuckDB union names.

showcase_chains.title: More SQL dialect fixes
showcase_chains.blurb: sqlglot again: a DuckDB union bug, ClickHouse's COLUMNS(…) APPLY syntax and BigQuery's RANGE type.

showcase_chains.title: Dates, JSON and generated columns
showcase_chains.blurb: sqlglot: T-SQL DATEPART(WEEK), BigQuery json_value escaping and Postgres STORED generated columns.

showcase_chains.title: 3D mesh and SVG fixes
showcase_chains.blurb: trimesh loads 3D meshes and 2D paths. Drop an unused dependency, import SVG rects and circles, pass check_volume through booleans, nest SVG transforms correctly.

showcase_chains.title: Smarter dataclass ↔ JSON conversion
showcase_chains.blurb: dataclasses-jsonschema turns Python dataclasses into JSON Schema. Convert enum fields, allow names starting with _, accept None for enums and nested objects.

showcase_chains.title: Brazilian postcode helpers
showcase_chains.blurb: brutils handles Brazilian data. Three small postcode (CEP) utilities: format one, generate a random valid one, strip its symbols.

showcase_chains.title: Track tables through SQL scripts
showcase_chains.blurb: sqllineage finds which tables a SQL script reads and writes. Handle temporary tables, CREATE TABLE … LIKE and case-insensitive names.
